findings.title: Single-droplet infrastructure has no environment isolation
findings.note: One droplet serves dev and (through the same module) prod flows.
findings.impact: Dev changes can affect prod; no blast-radius separation.
findings.recommendation: Separate state/workspaces and hosts per environment.

findings.title: Terraform state/backend and provider versions exist but drift checks are absent
evidence: no terraform plan job on PR
findings.recommendation: Add `terraform plan` on PR and a scheduled drift detection.

report:
Terraform + compose review; the single
droplet is the only compute. dev/prod compose and env examples differ, and the
dev infra workflow can destroy resources.
